notes: Fixes the sign-in screen getting stuck. On some PCs UseAlibi couldn't open your browser and the screen sat on "Waiting for sign-in…" with nothing to click — it now tries several ways to open your browser, and shows the sign-in link on screen if none of them work. On macOS the notarization ticket is stapled into the app itself, so it opens without the "Apple could not verify" warning even offline.
